goal: Integration operator can execute one bounded read-only order-list page with durable run counts and safe cursor advancement.
non_goals: Do not call a real XianGuanJia API, add a controller, scheduler, replay, or admin page.
Do not create any third-party write operation or place credentials/private recipient data in source, logs, fixtures, or responses.
Do not convert orders, allocate devices, or recursively split/retry windows in this slice.
expected_evidence: Focused list parsing, fixed-window, run-state, detail-refresh, and cursor-safety tests
Maven module test output and no-write-path scan
unsafe_assumptions: The existing xianyu_sync_run table is available from migration 001.
An order-list count above 10,000 is not safe to process as one window and must be split by a later planner.
stop_condition: Stop if the task requires an undocumented source field, a third-party write, recursive scheduling, an API controller, or files outside the scope lock.
